resources.string: JobFinder runs on your computer. Keep it open there, with your phone on the same Wi-Fi, and pick your computer below.
Not listed? Type its address below, or scan the code in the desktop app’s Settings.
For example 192.168.1.20:47821. The desktop app shows it in Settings → Phone pairing.
Your computer now shows a request. Click Allow there if it shows this code:
That is neither a computer address nor a JobFinder pairing code.
That address is outside your home or office network. Only computers on your local Wi-Fi can be paired.
%1$s is on this Wi-Fi but did not answer. On the computer, quit and restart JobFinder; if that doesn’t help, open Help there, then Open the setup, and fix the firewall step.
Your computer did not answer. Check that JobFinder is running on it and that both are on the same Wi-Fi.
The request was denied on the computer.
Nobody answered on the computer in time. Try again and click Allow there.
The computer is answering another phone. Try again in a moment.
The scanner could not start. Type the address instead.
The phone stops showing jobs from this computer until you pair it again.
%1$s is offline · showing this phone’s copy
This shows when your computer is back.
Your computer is offline. Changes are kept on this phone and sent when it is back.
Your computer is offline. You can change this when it is back.
Checks each step between this phone and %1$s.
Everything works. If jobs still don’t load, pull down to refresh.
The phone is not on Wi-Fi. Turn on Wi-Fi and join the same network as your computer.
The phone and the computer are on different networks (another Wi-Fi, mobile data or a VPN). Join the computer’s Wi-Fi and turn off any VPN.
The computer is not announcing itself. That is fine when the next checks pass; otherwise it may be off, or the Wi-Fi keeps devices apart (guest networks do).
The computer moved to a new address. The phone now uses it.

No answer. The computer may be asleep, or Windows Firewall is blocking JobFinder. On the computer, set this Wi-Fi to Private and allow JobFinder through the firewall (the desktop app’s setup guide does both).
The computer is on, but JobFinder is not running on it. Open JobFinder on the computer.
Something other than JobFinder answers at this address. Pair again to find your computer.
A different JobFinder computer answers at this address. Pair again to find yours.
JobFinder answered with an error. Restart it on the computer, then check again.
The computer no longer trusts this phone (its pairing code was renewed). Pair again.
Your saved searches found new jobs.
